raw_record.question_text:
The following figure shows a certain region of China. Read the figure and answer the following questions.

<image1>

At places M and N in the figure, toward what direction of the river do the ≥10°C accumulated temperature contour lines respectively bulge? What is the reason?
raw_record.standard_answer: Both bulge toward the upstream of the river, because they are located in valley areas

method.method_draft: First describe the map symbols: dashed curves are ≥10°C accumulated-temperature isolines, thin solid curves are rivers, and M、N are marked beside river valleys. For each of M and N, trace the nearby dashed isoline and compare its bulge with the adjacent river course; identify the bulge as pointing toward the river’s upstream/headwater direction. Then explain that both places lie in river valleys, where lower elevation and warmer thermal conditions make the accumulated-temperature belt extend farther along the valley than on surrounding slopes. Therefore both M and N isolines convex toward the river upstream.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中图例显示，虚线表示≥10℃等积温线，细实线表示河流；M位于图右下部的一条河谷附近，N位于图中偏左上部的一条河谷附近。M、N附近的虚线等积温线都在接近河流时发生弯曲，并沿河谷方向向河流源头一侧伸展。
推理：等积温线在河谷处向上游方向凸出，说明同一热量条件沿河谷可延伸到更靠近上游的位置。其主要原因是河谷地带地势较低，气温相对较高，≥10℃积温较大，因此等积温线沿河谷向上游弯曲突出。
method.model_answer: M、N两地的≥10℃等积温线都凸向河流上游。原因是两地位于河谷地带，海拔较低、气温较高，热量条件较好，使等积温线沿河谷向上游延伸。
